scope: Archive lightweight corrected-consensus and negative-evidence checkpoints.

evidence_gate/report.json.scope:
Evidence-only gate for native negative candidates, never training approval.

Consumes a hash-bound paired-BAM pilot report. Preserves every FILTER and source
record. Indels/complex contexts abstain pending haplotype-aware adjudication.
No caller votes are summed and missing coverage is never interpreted as zero.

rescue_validation/validation.json.scope:
Standalone first/realignment rescue validation from existing VCFs only.

Preparation is the default; --execute runs the two adapters and benchmarks.
Never launches Nextflow, alignment, variant calling or a cohort rerun.

first.negative_metric_interpretation: TP means known-somatic collision; not negative-class accuracy

recommended_truth/validation.json.scope:
Rebenchmark unchanged queries and baselines against an explicit alternate truth.

No consensus rerun or threshold fitting. Intended to distinguish historical
HG008 multi-sample truth from NIST's recommended tumorvariants representation.
